The sisterhoods act as mediators and rely on diplomacy rather than ruling through force. This has left them without the power and resources of other factions, dependent instead on an ever fragile web of alliances and donations. The rise of a gene-scientist, known to history as the Founder, to supreme ruler of humanity, resulted in a devastating war that soon engulfed Earth and its colonies. As the war grew more devastating, ... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/blessed-sisters) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Devout: When attacking, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). ### Special Rules Casting Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight with Caster, which gets -1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Courage Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Devout Boost: If this model has Devout, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9" away, it deals extra hits on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Devout (instead of only on 6). Disintegrate: Ignores Regeneration, and against units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Guarded Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Guarded once (next time the effect would apply). Piercing Assault: This model gets AP(+1) when charging. Point-Blank Surge: When this model shoots at enemies within 12", unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Precision Fighter Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply). Precision Shooter Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Precision Target(X): Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking it. Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Spell Conduit: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken. ### Aura Special Rules Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Devout Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Devout Boost. Fast Aura: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions. Fortified Aura: This model and its unit get Fortified. Increased Shooting Range Aura: This model and its unit get +6" range when shooting. Point-Blank Piercing Aura: This model and its unit get Point-Blank Piercing. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Shred in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Shred in melee. Read more ### Spells Burn the Heretic (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which gets -3 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Righteous Wrath (1): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 1 hit with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Holy Rage (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Piercing Hunter once (next time the effect would apply). Eternal Flame (2): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 6 hits with Disintegrate. Litanies of War (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Devout Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Searing Admonition (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 3 hits with Blast(3). ### Units ### Heroes Exo-Suit High Sister [1] Qua 4+Def 3+ 185pts Great Energy Sword(A6, AP(2), Rending),
